findings.title: Unparseable doctor output crashes the SessionStart hook
findings.description: The hook JSON.parses the doctor output, and a doctor that prints anything but JSON throws out of run(), so the SessionStart hook crashes instead of starting the session.
findings.suggestion: Catch the parse and fall back to a one-line message.

findings.title: Multi-line fix text loses its indentation in the preflight block
findings.description: Each continuation line of a multi-line fix is trimmed before it is re-indented, so a fix whose lines are nested (a command under a step) prints flat and the nesting is lost.
findings.suggestion: Strip only the fix's common leading indent, not each line's own.

findings.title: The preflight closer warns users off spec and bootstrap when only ship is blocked
findings.description: The closer line is a constant: whatever check failed, it tells the person to apply the fixes before /interlock:spec, /interlock:bootstrap or /interlock:ship. A test-profile, allowlist or git failure blocks only an unattended ship, and spec and bootstrap run past it, so a fresh install is told it cannot author a change when it can.
findings.suggestion: Name spec and bootstrap only when an openspec or binaries check is among the failures; otherwise name ship alone.
